items.question: How many annual leave days do employees get?
items.ground_truth: Employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year and may carry over up to 5 unused days to the next calendar year.
items.answer: The company provides 25 days of paid annual leave per year.
contexts: The company provides 25 days of paid annual leave per year. Employees may carry over up to 5 unused days to the next calendar year.

items.question: Can unused leave days be transferred to the next year?
items.ground_truth: Yes, up to 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over to the next calendar year.
items.answer: Employees may carry over up to 5 unused days to the next calendar year.
contexts: The company provides 25 days of paid annual leave per year. Employees may carry over up to 5 unused days to the next calendar year.
